About Us
YOUR BRAND,
EVERYWHERE

SK TechInfoMedia is Gujarat's trusted 360° advertising, printing, branding, digital & event solutions company — helping businesses of all sizes reach their audience.

From grassroots auto-rickshaw campaigns across Gujarat's villages to premium mall and metro branding in city centres — we deliver results at every touchpoint.

Whether you need outdoor hoardings, vehicle wraps, wall paintings, digital campaigns or complete event management, we bring your vision to life.
